text:
West Shore School District four-year graduation rate drops to 89.7% in 2024-25
K. P. Banks
West Shore School District in York County posted an 89.7% four-year cohort graduation rate for the 2024-25 school year, according to the Pennsylvania Department of Education.
Of 601 students in the cohort who started high school four years prior, 539 graduated.
The rate was 91.9% in 2023-24, a decline of 2.2 percentage points in 2024-25.
Pennsylvania's four-year cohort graduation rate measures the percentage of students in a cohort who graduate within four years. These stories use the graduation rate, graduate count and cohort count the Pennsylvania Department of Education reports for the school district itself; they are not aggregated from individual schools. Suppressed or unavailable values are not converted into exact figures and are not used for exact comparisons, calculations or rankings.
Pennsylvania's four-year high school graduation rate was 88% in the 2024-25 school year, according to the Pennsylvania Department of Education. The rate rose from 87.6% in 2023-24 and 87% in 2022-23, the third straight year of improvement.

| 2022-23 | 89.4% |
| 2023-24 | 91.9% |
| 2024-25 | 89.7% |
Information in this article comes from the Pennsylvania Department of Education's high school graduation reports.
